complicacoes.texto: Aztek has trained since childhood com the Q Foundation to be the champion of the Aztec god Quetzalcoatl e battle evil in the world.
Though a stalwart hero, Aztek has lived most of his life in the isolation of the Q Foundation’s South American enclave e is often uncomfortable interacting com the larger world.

Aztek needs to use the Helmet of Quetzalcoatl to Invocar his 4-D Gauntlets e Costume of the Champion. He still has access to their Poderes if he loses the helmet after summoning them, however. the Lizard King, e the Q Foundation itself, when it was revealed that the ancient e benevolent society is actually funded by Lex Luthor.
